scope: Historical macOS experiments plus completed Linux/macOS/Windows CI and final published v0.2.1 HTTPS installation evidence. Earlier staging archive observations remain historical, not final release evidence.

harness.invocation: Current Node executes npm-cli.js exec --yes --cache <fresh cache> --global=false --package=<archive> -- kin --no-open --port <free loopback port>.
harness.windowsBoundary: Structured arguments through Node avoid interpolating archive URLs through npm.cmd. Cleanup uses bounded taskkill.exe /PID <owned process> /T /F plus listener-closure verification; this is not a POSIX graceful signal.
harness.isolation: Every invocation creates an empty cache, unrelated working directory and KIN_DATA_DIR. It removes inherited KIN_*, PORT, RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN, NODE_PATH and NODE_OPTIONS. Cleanup removes only its owned temporary directory.
checks: Lockfile resolves the exact requested URL or local archive; installed manifest name/version and bin exist.
Installed --version matches for releases 0.2.1 or newer; 0.2.0 predates this option.
Local health reports local-demo; relay health reports kin-relay/0.1 and encrypted-payloads.
Root HTML and nonempty built JavaScript/CSS assets are served; external working directory remains empty.
macOS npm-exec process group exits after SIGTERM and listener closes without SIGKILL.
For 0.2.1, a second process using the same data directory is rejected before serving; the first process remains healthy.
Linux/macOS SIGTERM exits and removes the process lock. Windows smoke uses scoped process-tree termination and does not establish graceful shutdown or lock removal.
harness.metrics: Wall-clock observations, not guarantees. Total time stops before temporary-directory deletion. Byte counts sum logical regular-file lengths without following symlinks, not allocated disk usage. This harness uses prebuilt assets and does not run or time a source UI build.

noGitExperiment.passingSetup: PATH contained only the existing Node/npm bin directory and a temporary directory containing a symlink named sh to /bin/sh. Before launch, spawning git --version with exactly this environment returned ENOENT.
noGitExperiment.machineGit: Git remains installed on the machine. These runs prove Git unavailable through PATH, not a machine with Git uninstalled.
noGitExperiment.negativeExperiment: Both versions failed npm/esbuild installation with spawn sh ENOENT when PATH contained only Node/npm. npm_config_script_shell=/bin/sh did not supply that dependency lifecycle path. Supplying sh on PATH while still excluding Git passed.

ciReview.statusAtObservation: completed: required checks, local-packed installer matrix, public HTTPS installer matrix and Pages succeeded
findings: All three operating systems completed real npm-exec installation from local packed archives and the exact published v0.2.1 HTTPS URL, with fresh caches, unrelated working directories and isolated data.
All three operating systems verified --version and second-process denial for the same data directory.
Windows cleanup is scoped process-tree termination; graceful shutdown and automatic marker removal are not established by its installer smoke.
Linux/macOS public installer jobs and the final local macOS run verified SIGTERM exit and lock removal.

requiredCI.container: Docker stop/restart removed the process lock and retained a writable-volume sentinel. This is a shutdown/restart smoke, not a power-loss proof.

publicHTTPSInstallerCI.source: Manually dispatched public-installer workflow; automatic tag-triggered duplicate is not the cited evidence.

limits: Requires preinstalled Node.js 22.19 or newer with npm, a lifecycle shell and internet access for production dependencies.
Published-archive CI readiness observations were 5.981 seconds on Linux, 11.062 seconds on macOS and 56.839 seconds on Windows. They are measurements of single runs, not installation-time guarantees.
Logical cache files ranged from 135391188 to 146446601 bytes across the final public CI runs; network, time and allocated disk requirements vary.

Installer smoke does not exercise interactive browser rendering, ChatGPT/Claude accounts, human outcomes, remote managed hosting or paid services. The separate 32-check browser CI is automated local app evidence.

Recorded GitHub asset digests are advertised metadata. The install smoke checks exact requested archive URL and installed version; this documentation task did not independently download and hash the archive.
Release URLs are versioned but assets are not established as immutable. v0.2.1 remains an experimental prerelease.
Forced Windows process-tree cleanup removes only isolated test fixtures; it is not evidence that production stale locks can be safely removed automatically.
